title: Build compact upgrade guides and exec-ready one-pagers for launches
creator: Rae Mendoza
description: Goal: Create a set of compact, audience-tailored artifacts that make feature upgrades easy to communicate and act on for customers and execs. Deliverables: (1) a 1-page executive summary per major feature that highlights user impact, rollout plan, and rollback criteria; (2) a short upgrade guide (2-3 pages) for engineers and platform teams covering migration steps, API changes, example curl/snippets, and common troubleshooting; (3) a condensed customer-facing changelog entry (3-4 bullets) suitable for in-product and email. These assets must be embargo-ready, localized to en/fr/de (lightweight), and include a redaction checklist for legal/Security review.
success_metrics:
- Exec summaries approved by GTM and VP Product within 3 business days of draft
- Customer-facing changelog conversion CTR > 8% on staged email
- Support ticket rate for upgraded customers < 1.5x baseline in first 72 hours
- Docs deployed to docs.redwood.ai and linked from release notes

acceptance_criteria: One exec-ready 1-pager and one upgrade guide template published to Confluence
